title: Safe Pricing Framework (PPP)
description: Reference implementation of the PPP (Premium, Promotion, Penetration) safe-pricing method by Dr. Mostafa Nawareg for launching new products: an even premium anchor from the quality leader, an odd promotional price 10% below the market leader, a safe price zone, and break-even analysis. Live calculator: https://marketingplannerai.mostafanawareg.com/marketing-template.html#tool-pricing-safe
